title: 🚨 YOU DON’T HAVE A BIBLE READING PROBLEM. YOU MIGHT HAVE A BIBLE INTERPRETATION PROBLEM.
paragraphs: 🚨 YOU DON’T HAVE A BIBLE READING PROBLEM. YOU MIGHT HAVE A BIBLE INTERPRETATION PROBLEM.
Millions of Christians read Scripture.
Yet many still feel confused.
Still feel stuck.
Still struggle to hear God's voice clearly.
Why?
Because reading the Bible and understanding the Bible are not the same thing.
Some people build entire beliefs on a single verse taken out of context.
Others read their opinions into Scripture instead of letting Scripture shape their opinions.
And the result?

❌ Confusion
❌ Spiritual immaturity
❌ Misapplied promises
❌ Unnecessary doubt
That is exactly why I created this powerful new resource:

📖 HOW TO INTERPRET SCRIPTURE CORRECTLY
A Biblical Guide to Understanding God's Word Faithfully
It's a practical guide designed to help believers stop guessing and start understanding God's Word with confidence.
Because God's Word was never meant to be twisted.
It was meant to transform.

• How to study verses in their proper context
• The #1 mistake that causes Bible confusion
• How to avoid common interpretation errors
• How to distinguish what Scripture describes vs. what it commands
• How to interpret difficult passages using other Scriptures
• How to keep Christ at the center of Bible study
• A simple framework you can use every time you open your Bible
📖 Key Scripture:

"Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of truth."
— 2 Timothy 2:15
⚔️ THE REAL DIFFERENCE
Most people want quick inspiration.
Few people want deep transformation.
Most people collect Bible verses.
Few people learn how to interpret them correctly.
Most people want God to agree with them.
Few people are willing to let God's Word correct them.
The believers who grow the most are not necessarily those who read more.
They are those who understand and apply what they read.
Which group are you becoming?
🔥 THIS IS BIGGER THAN A BOOK
This is part of a movement.
A movement to help believers know Scripture.
Love Scripture.
Defend Scripture.
And live Scripture.
